verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. Authy's documentation only describes encrypted backup and sync to its own cloud, with no export feature. Community reports consistently say there is no export option; the only ways out are unofficial hacks (debug-mode Electron scripts, a deprecated Chrome extension, a third-party GitHub tool), and user-side workarounds earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
